visual_identity.core_identity: A disciplined martial goblinoid with a controlled soldierly bearing, more organized and sturdier than a goblin but not orc-like.
visual_identity.silhouette: Medium athletic humanoid, squared shoulders, upright military stance, compact disciplined posture behind shield and weapon.
visual_identity.head_features: Angular goblinoid face, pointed ears smaller than a goblin's exaggerated ears, strong brow, short nose, stern eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Lean athletic humanoid with balanced proportions and trained posture rather than oversized muscles.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly smooth skin with sparse scars; armor surfaces kept broad and simple.

accuracy_checks: shield and weapon are practical and readable

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
